# Apostille San Francisco

> Private apostille concierge in San Francisco. Documents are checked before any filing, filed in person at the California Secretary of State (or hand-carried to the U.S. Department of State for federal documents), translated and legalized when the destination needs it, and delivered tracked anywhere. Not a law firm; we do not provide legal advice.

## Pricing (USD, per document unless stated; confirmed in writing before work starts)

- $45 Document Check: written answer within one business day. $20 of the $45 is credited toward your apostille.
- California mail-in (no rush): $180, usually 2–4 weeks. Mail-in clients send documents already notarized; notarization is not offered on this tier.
- California same-day emergency: $450, filed in person the same business day when the counter allows.
- Three documents, one emergency trip: $650.
- Notarization add-on: $100 (up to 3 signatures, travel up to 15 miles included). Available only with the $450 same-day and $650 three-document service. Notarization is never included in any tier.
- Federal apostille (U.S. Department of State): $350.
- Name-change petition + federal apostille: $550.
- State + federal apostille + embassy legalization (non-Hague destinations): $600.
- Certified translation: quoted per document by page and language.
- No guarantees of acceptance or turnaround; timeframes are estimates.

## California Secretary of State facts

- State fee: $20 per apostille, the same by mail and in person.
- Special handling fee: $6 for each different public official's signature, for in-person requests only. It does not apply to mail requests.
- Mail payment: $20 per apostille, check or money order payable to "Secretary of State".
- Mail by USPS: Secretary of State, Notary Public Section, P.O. Box 942877, Sacramento, CA 94277-0001
- Mail by private carrier: Secretary of State, Notary Public Section, 1500 11th Street, 2nd Floor, Sacramento, CA 95814
- Sacramento counter: 1500 11th Street, 3rd Floor, Sacramento, CA 95814 (cash, Visa/Mastercard, check, money order)
- Los Angeles office: 300 South Spring Street, Room 12513, Los Angeles, CA 90013 (no cash). Temporarily serving on the 1st floor, Suite 1215, due to an elevator outage (per SOS, Oct 2026).

## Hague Apostille Convention status

- Vietnam: Hague member, in force 11 September 2026. Use an apostille, not embassy legalization.
- Thailand: joins 28 February 2027. Until then, documents for Thailand follow the legalization route.
- UAE: not a Hague member. Legalization route.
- China: Hague member since 7 November 2023.

## Apostille by country

- [Nineteen destinations. Seventeen take the apostille. Two need the embassy.](https://apostillesanfrancisco.com/apostille-by-country/): Apostille guidance country by country for Italy, Mexico, Spain, China, Brazil and more: Hague status, consulate requirements, and translation rules.
- [Argentina. Hague since 1988. No consulate step.](https://apostillesanfrancisco.com/apostille-for-argentina/): California apostille for Argentina covers citizenship by descent, residency, marriage and real estate. Hague since 1988, with sworn Spanish translation.
- [Australia. Hague since 1995. No consulate step.](https://apostillesanfrancisco.com/apostille-for-australia/): California apostille for Australia — partner visa (subclass 309/100, 820/801), skilled migration, working holiday, employment. Hague Convention since 1995.
- [Brazil. Hague since 2016. No consulate step.](https://apostillesanfrancisco.com/apostille-for-brazil/): California apostille for Brazil covers residency, marriage at the cartório, and citizenship for U.S.-born children of Brazilian parents. Hague since 2016.
- [China. Hague since Nov 2023. No consular stamp.](https://apostillesanfrancisco.com/apostille-for-china/): California apostille for mainland China — Hague Convention member since November 2023, replacing consular legalization. Hong Kong and Macao long-time members.
- [France. Hague since 1965. No consulate step.](https://apostillesanfrancisco.com/apostille-for-france/): California apostille for France — long-stay visa (visa long séjour), marriage at the mairie, PACS partnership, employment. Hague Convention since 1965.
- [Germany. Hague since 1966. No consulate step.](https://apostillesanfrancisco.com/apostille-for-germany/): California apostille for Germany — residency permits, marriage abroad, employment authorization, FBI background checks, and certified German translation.
- [India. Hague since 2005. Apostille first.](https://apostillesanfrancisco.com/apostille-for-india/): India and the United States are both Hague parties, so a California apostille replaces consular legalization. OCI, marriage and employment files.
- [Ireland. Hague since 1999. No consulate step.](https://apostillesanfrancisco.com/apostille-for-ireland/): California apostille for Ireland covers the Foreign Births Register, marriage and residency. Hague since 1999, with no consulate step or translation.
- [Italy. Hague since 1978. No consulate step.](https://apostillesanfrancisco.com/apostille-for-italy/): California apostille for Italy — long-form vital records for jure sanguinis citizenship, Italian translation, and SF Consulate coordination.
- [Japan. Hague since 1970. No consulate step.](https://apostillesanfrancisco.com/apostille-for-japan/): California apostille for Japan — spouse visa, marriage at the ward office (kuyakusho), employment, Japanese translation. Hague Convention since 1970.
- [Mexico. Hague since 1995. No consulate step.](https://apostillesanfrancisco.com/apostille-for-mexico/): California apostille for Mexico — real estate POA, dual citizenship, FM3 residency, divorce decree judge-signature certification, Spanish translation.
- [Philippines. Hague since 2019. No red ribbon.](https://apostillesanfrancisco.com/apostille-for-philippines/): California apostille for Philippines — marriage recording with PSA, dual citizenship under RA 9225, real estate, business. Hague Convention since May 2019.
- [Portugal. Hague since 1969. Six-month clock.](https://apostillesanfrancisco.com/apostille-for-portugal/): The Portuguese Consulate in San Francisco asks for a long-form birth certificate apostilled within six months. Portugal has been Hague since 1969.
- [South Korea. Hague since 2007. No consulate step.](https://apostillesanfrancisco.com/apostille-for-south-korea/): California apostille for South Korea — F-2 / F-4 / F-6 spouse and descent visa, marriage registration, employment, Korean translation. Hague since 2007.
- [Spain. Hague since 1978. No consulate step.](https://apostillesanfrancisco.com/apostille-for-spain/): California apostille for Spain — spousal residency, Sephardic citizenship, Latin America descent pathway, Spanish translation by traductor jurado.
- [United Kingdom. Hague since 1965. No consulate step.](https://apostillesanfrancisco.com/apostille-for-united-kingdom/): California apostille for United Kingdom — UK settlement visa, marriage in the U.K., employment, education. Hague Convention since 1965; no embassy legalization.
- [Vietnam. Hague since 11 September 2026. No embassy step.](https://apostillesanfrancisco.com/apostille-for-vietnam/): Vietnam joined the Hague Apostille Convention on 11 September 2026. California documents for Vietnam now take an apostille, not embassy legalization.
- [Thailand. Legalization until 28 February 2027. Apostille after.](https://apostillesanfrancisco.com/thailand-document-legalization/): Thailand joins the Hague Apostille Convention on 28 February 2027. Until then, California documents need state, federal and Thai embassy legalization.
- [UAE. Not a Hague country. Legalization, not apostille.](https://apostillesanfrancisco.com/uae-document-legalization/): The UAE is not a Hague country, so an apostille is not the last step. Documents need California authentication, then UAE Embassy and MOFAIC legalization.

- [California Death Certificate Apostille](https://apostillesanfrancisco.com/california-death-certificate-apostille/): A California death certificate apostille uses certified copies from CDPH or the County Recorder, plus the $20 state fee. Estates, insurance, citizenship.
- [Apostille Your California Diploma or Degree](https://apostillesanfrancisco.com/california-diploma-apostille/): A California diploma apostille takes a notarized copy or a registrar-certified copy, plus the $20 state fee. A $45 Document Check confirms it first.
- [California Divorce Decree Apostille](https://apostillesanfrancisco.com/california-divorce-decree-apostille/): A California divorce decree apostille needs a Superior Court certified copy, county clerk certification where required, and the $20 state fee.
- [California Marriage Certificate Apostille](https://apostillesanfrancisco.com/california-marriage-certificate-apostille/): California marriage certificate apostille — certified copies from CDPH or the County Recorder where the marriage was filed. $20 SOS fee. Foreign marriage uses.
- [California Transcript Apostille](https://apostillesanfrancisco.com/california-transcript-apostille/): California transcript apostille — sealed registrar transcript or notarized copy, $20 SOS fee. Pair with diploma apostille for foreign credential evaluations.
- [Corporate Documents Apostille California](https://apostillesanfrancisco.com/corporate-documents-apostille-california/): California corporate documents apostille quickly and correctly. We handle notarization and Secretary of State processing with expedited service available.
- [Apostille Your FBI Background Check](https://apostillesanfrancisco.com/fbi-background-check-apostille-california/): An FBI background check is federal, so its apostille comes from the U.S. Department of State, not California. We prepare the full package for $350.
- [California Power Of Attorney Apostille](https://apostillesanfrancisco.com/power-of-attorney-apostille-california/): California power of attorney apostille — notarized POA, California notary commission verified, $20 SOS fee. International real estate, banking, and inheritance.
